scope: Intermediate custom attribute batch implementation; source under remediation

findings.detail: Temporary constructor/field/property buffer fixups were not relocated into the final buffer.
Global MetadataPool access from conversion requires synchronization.
Completed attribute state and pointer readers require synchronized publication.
Aggregate type-index bounds and final allocation must be checked before appending.
Writer resize must commit pointer and capacity together after allocation succeeds.
